analyst.summary: NMDC is India's largest iron-ore miner, riding a strong volume ramp (record Q1 FY27 production, guiding to 60 million tonnes for the full year) and three rounds of price hikes through FY26 that pushed FY26 profit to a record Rs7,415 crore. The balance sheet is very clean (almost no debt, high returns on capital) and the stock trades cheaply at under 10x trailing earnings, but this is still a single-commodity cyclical business - iron ore prices can turn as fast as they rose, and one recent quarter (Q3 FY26) already showed profit falling even as revenue grew, on rising costs. We rate it a Hold: good operating momentum and a cheap valuation, balanced by commodity-cycle risk that argues against paying up further.
